hero.title: Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries
hero.subtitle: Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

welcome.title: Welcome to Our Church
welcome.subtitle: A Place of Faith, Love, and Community
welcome.description: We are a family of believers dedicated to spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ, nurturing spiritual growth, and serving our community in Addis Ababa and beyond. Join us as we seek to bring heaven to earth through prayer, worship, and love.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To make disciples of all nations, teaching them to observe all that Christ has commanded, and bringing the Kingdom of God to every home and community.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To see families transformed by the power of the Gospel, communities renewed by the love of Christ, and nations reached with the message of salvation.

prayer.title: Prayer Ministry
prayer.description: 24/7 prayer coverage, prayer vigils, and intercession for families and nations.

outreach.title: Community Outreach
outreach.description: Food distribution, helping the needy, and showing Christ's love through action.

discipleship.title: Discipleship
discipleship.description: Bible studies, small groups, and spiritual mentoring for growth in faith.

youth.title: Youth Ministry
youth.description: Weekly meetings, mentorship, and activities for young believers.

children.title: Children's Ministry
children.description: Sunday School, Bible stories, and nurturing the faith of our little ones.

worship.title: Worship Ministry
worship.description: Leading the congregation in Spirit-filled worship through music and arts.

women.title: Women's Ministry
women.description: Empowering women to grow in faith and support one another in community.

missions.title: Missions
missions.description: Spreading the Gospel to unreached communities in Ethiopia and beyond.

hero.title: Our Ministries
hero.subtitle: Discover how you can get involved and grow in your faith journey

getInvolved.title: Get Involved
getInvolved.description: God has given each of us unique gifts and talents. We'd love to help you discover your calling and find a place to serve in our church family.

hero.title: About Our Ministry
hero.description: Discover our story, beliefs, and the team behind Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries was founded in 2005 with a vision to create a place where people can experience the love and power of God in their lives.

beliefs.title: Our Core Beliefs
beliefs.subtitle: What we stand for and believe in

bible.title: The Bible
bible.description: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God, the supreme authority for faith and life.

trinity.title: The Trinity
trinity.description: We believe in one God, eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.description: We believe salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone, not by works.

church.title: The Church
church.description: We believe in the universal church as the body of Christ, called to worship, fellowship, and mission.

returnOfChrist.title: The Return of Christ
returnOfChrist.description: We believe in the personal, visible return of Jesus Christ to establish His Kingdom.

pastorAbraham.name: Pastor Abraham
pastorAbraham.description: Leading our congregation with vision and compassion for over 15 years.

sisterTigist.name: Sister Tigist
sisterTigist.description: Dedicated to empowering women through faith and fellowship.

brotherDaniel.name: Brother Daniel
brotherDaniel.description: Passionate about raising the next generation of believers.
